hints.text: Go back to your tree: which jobs are pure calculations and which ones read or write?
with name, price and stock in a vector; pure functions for the price, the discount and the valid code; the main algorithm reads, checks and shows.
Check in order: code, amount and stock. Only if all three pass, take off the stock, put the card back in the vector, write the line and add. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Also show how many sales were rejected during the day and for which reason.

The app's closed catalogue of checks cannot count pure functions or require a record: the restriction asks for them, and the cases tell the three rejections apart with their exact reason. Hidden cases: a sale that leaves the stock exactly at 0 and the next one rejected, a sale of 0 units, everything rejected, sales that use up three products, stock rejections after accepted sales and a single sale.
